system.name: Green Oaks
system.description: Everyone plays a Senior at the Green Oaks retirement home: what they were back in the day, the career they retired from, and what they're into now. Checks are card draws from a poker deck, because dice are for youths.
system.credits: A role-playing game by Roberto de Luca. Published by MS Edizioni under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

showConfig._comment: Audience builds Green Oaks townsfolk (NPCs the cast's Seniors run into), not Seniors. Blind collection like Honey Heist; the reputation prompt shows its sentence lead-in on purpose. showId is the Firestore episode id = config/platform.currentShowId.

pitch.hook: The cast plays the Seniors. You build the town they terrorize.
pitch.genreNote: If you love Bubba Ho-Tep, Buffy, or Red — no rules knowledge needed.

audienceActions.label: Build a townie
audienceActions.detail: Scan the QR and give Green Oaks a resident: a name, a job, and the thing everyone in town whispers about them.

audienceActions.label: Watch them get dragged in
audienceActions.detail: The Seniors might need your townie. Your townie might regret it.

npcCreation.revealTemplate: The {adjective} {occupation}. Everyone in Green Oaks knows they {reputation}.

copy.createSubtitle: Give us a townie. The Seniors might run into them.
copy.myNpcSubtitle: Come to the show and find out if the Seniors run into them.
copy.showPageBlurb: Give the town a resident before the show. The Seniors will take it from there.
